title: Day 791: Motorcyclist Ambushed and Shot Dead in Mazatlán's Emiliano Zapata Neighborhood
detail: At around 9:40 PM on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, armed men waited for a motorcyclist at the corner of Libramiento Colosio and Emiliano Zapata street in Mazatlán's Colonia Emiliano Zapata, intercepted him and fired six shots at close range until he stopped moving. The victim, a man believed to be 30–35 years old, was pronounced dead at the scene by Bomberos Veteranos paramedics; he remained unidentified as of the report. Municipal police, Federal Protection Service agents, and Army and Navy personnel established a security perimeter while state prosecutors conducted the forensic investigation.

media.caption: Security forces at the scene where a motorcyclist was shot dead in Mazatlán's Colonia Emiliano Zapata, September 22, 2026

title: Day 791: State Police Repel Gunfire from Armed Civilians Near Las Bateas, South of Culiacán
detail: At approximately 10:56 PM on September 22, 2026, State Preventive Police and the Grupo de Operaciones Especiales de Sinaloa (GOES) conducting patrols near the Las Bateas community in the Costa Rica sindicatura, south of Culiacán, were fired on by occupants of a pickup truck. Officers repelled the aggression and pursued the vehicle. Two armed civilians were detained, one of them wounded and hospitalized. Authorities seized two 5.56×45mm rifles, 12 magazines, 339 rounds, two ballistic vests and a gray Nissan NP300/Frontier pickup that had been reported stolen.

media.caption: Weapons and a detained suspect after an armed confrontation near Las Bateas, Costa Rica sindicatura, south of Culiacán, September 22, 2026

title: Day 791: Two Detained After Gunfight with Security Forces During Attempted Land Rover Carjacking in Downtown Culiacán
detail: Shortly before midnight on September 22, 2026, two suspects — ages 18 and 19 — attempted to steal a black four-door Land Rover Defender at gunpoint on Avenida Venustiano Carranza in downtown Culiacán. An Interinstitutional Group of federal and state security personnel conducting surveillance nearby moved in; the suspects opened fire on the officers, who returned fire under protocol, and the Land Rover overturned during the confrontation. Both suspects were detained, one wounded and treated at the scene. Authorities seized two firearms, including an AK-47-pattern rifle, three magazines and 72 rounds.

media.caption: The overturned Land Rover Defender after a gunfight with security forces in downtown Culiacán, September 22, 2026

title: Day 791: Arrest Warrant Executed in Puebla Against 'El Dron' for Livestreamed Killing of Influencer César Gastélum
detail: Ministerial agents of Sinaloa's Fiscalía, working with UNESA elements, executed a formal apprehension order in Puebla state on September 22, 2026, against Jesús Alberto 'N', 25, alias 'El Dron' — nearly seven weeks after he was first detained on August 30, 2026 on separate charges (attempted homicide, crimes against public officials, drug possession, and unauthorized possession of a military-grade firearm). Investigators from Sinaloa's Homicide Investigation Unit identify him as the primary suspect in the August 4, 2026 shooting death of TikTok influencer César Gastélum, who was killed while livestreaming in the parking lot of a KFC in Culiacán's Tres Ríos development. The order was carried out outside Sinaloa territory, in Puebla.
